title: Market Operations Engineer - Demand Response (Hybrid)
description:
At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources.  We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career.

ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future.

Job Description Summary
Work with interested Loads (potential Market Participants) through the registration / qualification / testing to become a Load Resource/Market Participant capable of providing ancillary services at ERCOT.

In this position, you will be utilizing SQL to run queries and Excel to analyze operational data pertaining to loads. You will be working directly with potential Market Participants communicating operational requirements as well as resolving performance issues. This role also requires forward-thinking awareness of evolving market and grid trends to anticipate how they may impact Demand Response participation.

Job Description

- Monitors system conditions and market performance of the wholesale electricity market.

- Works closely with both internal and external stakeholders concerning issues related to the wholesale market construct within the ERCOT Protocols.

- Helps ensure consistency and stability of the market.

- Acquires the skills and knowledge to provide engineering and analytical support for the wholesale market and grid operations.

- Prepares and validates models of the electric power systems.

- Applies principles of electricity market theory to understand market behavior and outcomes.

- Investigates methods for data analysis to develop improved analytical tools.

- Generates and maintains market reports per requests and protocols.

- Assists the management team and senior experts in providing technical assistance to PUCT, industry and stakeholder groups.

- Recommends, reviews and tests proposed changes to the ERCOT wholesale market systems and design.

- Under supervision, helps to ensure all wholesale market activities have been successfully completed per protocols and works closely with Market Participants to resolve issues concerning wholesale market and grid operations.

- Attends stakeholder, industry, and PUCT meetings under the direction of the ERCOT management team

- Generates and maintains market reports per requests and protocols

- Proposes and creates new solutions for data acquisition and reporting

- Assists the management team and senior experts in providing technical assistance to PUCT, industry and Stakeholder groups

- Attends stakeholder, industry, and PUCT meetings and provides input when requested

- Uses judgment and provides remedies for Market Participants disputes within the ERCOT market

- Addresses Market Participant questions pertaining to the daily market and grid operations activities

- Works independently and escalates issues to the Supervisor and/or Manager in a timely manner when necessary

- Develops strong working relationships with other internal departments

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Level 1: Requires no minimum job related experience in excess of degree requirements

- Level 2:  Requires minimum 1 year job related work experience in excess of degree requirements

- Level 3:  Requires minimum 3 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements

- Senior: Requires minimum 5 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements

Salary and level will be based on overall experience as determined by ERCOT.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

- Knowledge and experience in the field of Demand Response.

- Knowledge and experience working with electrical distribution systems (25 KV and under) and/or Distributed Energy Resources (DER’s).

- Experience facilitating revisions to Protocol and Other Binding Document language through internal processes, including project requirements, implementation, and testing.

- Performing Protocol, Other Binding Document, and general reporting audit functions.

- Demonstrates proficient technical skills with common business applications such as SQL, Python, EXCEL, and PowerPoint.

- Comfortable utilizing artificial intelligence tools to support analysis, reporting, or research tasks.

EDUCATION

- Bachelor's Degree: Electrical Engineering (Required)

- or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge to a major in such fields is required

WORK LOCATION – Taylor, TX:

- Employees will be required to be on-site in Taylor, TX at minimum 2 days per week, or more, as needed based on the business needs as determined by management

- Remote work is required to be performed from your Texas residence.

title: Generation Interconnection Engineer 3
description:
At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources.  We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career.

ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future.

JOB SUMMARY
Responsible for coordinating the integration of generation and energy storage resources into the ERCOT System from the initial application for entry into the Generation Interconnection or Change Request (GINR) process to the approval for commercial operations. This responsibility will include performing security screening studies, reviewing and approving Full Interconnection Study (FIS) scope and study reports, review of the Standard Generation Interconnection Agreement (SGIA), review of compliance with ERCOT protocols and market rules, development and approval of modeling data for all phases of the interconnection, support for modeling the generation resource in the Network Model Management System (NMMS) model, Commissioning Plan review and Energization, Synchronization, and Commissioning checklist completion.

Essential Job Duties and Tasks

- Manages the integration of generation and energy storage resources through the entire generation interconnection process from the initial application to the approval for
the commercial operations.

- Ensures that the interconnection of generation and energy storage resources are accomplished in a manner that maintains the reliability of the ERCOT System and complies with the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reliability Standards, ERCOT Protocols, Planning Guide and the Operating Guides. Works closely with Market Participants (MPs), including Interconnecting Entities (IEs), Resource entities (REs), Distribution Service Providers (DSPs), and Transmission Service Providers (TSPs).

- Works closely with ERCOT System Operations, System Operations Support, Market Operating Services Support, Client Services, System Planning and Metering.

- Reviews and processes generation interconnection and full interconnection study (FIS) applications.

- Performs security screening studies to determine first contingency incremental transfer capability for each interconnection request.

- Attends FIS kickoff meetings, communicates and works with MPs and other ERCOT departments to solve issues related to generation interconnection projects.

- Reviews and approves Reactive Study reports, FIS scope and reports, and SGIA .

- Reviews and approves modeling data for all phases of the interconnection process, supports Network Modeling to model the generation resource in the NMMS model .

- Reviews Commissioning Plan and Energization, Synchronization, and Commissioning checklists.

- Reviews commissioning testing data, including but not limited to AVR/PSS, and Reactive tests.

- Develops and maintains tools that automates the studies, reviews, and other processes.

- Provides training to less experienced engineers.

- Reviews, drafts, and implements improvements to the interconnection and modeling process

- Reviews, drafts, and presents: changes to the Protocols, Guides, procedures, training material for other engineers and for MPs, and other supporting ERCOT documents relative to modeling.

EXPECTATIONS

- Power systems background preferred

- Be able to effectively communicate

- Be able to effectively manage time and prioritize

- Be able to work independently on assignments and projects

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION

- Bachelor's Degree : Electrical Engineering or related field(s) (Required)

- or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge to a major in such fields is required

Work Experience

Engineer 2

- Minimum 1 to 2 years (in excess of degree requirements stated above) of progressively responsible experience as a power system engineer or similar type role.

- Experience within the electric utility industry preferred.

Engineer 3

- Minimum 3 years (in excess of degree requirements stated above) of progressively responsible experience as a power system engineer or similar type role.

- Experience within the electric utility industry preferred.

Senior Engineer

- Requires minimum 5 years related work experience in excess of degree requirements.

Position is open to a level 2 or level 3 Engineer depending on the candidate's experience that is identified.

description:

JOB SUMMARY
The Settlement Analyst performs settlement calculations for the ERCOT nodal market and responds to inquiries from Market Participants' Account Representatives. Analysts build deep expertise in settlement calculations and support projects to implement and enhance ERCOT's Commercial Operations Systems. Serves as the subject matter expert for settlement of the ERCOT nodal market. Develops protocol language and system requirements related to Settlements. Creates test cases, test scripts, test data, and validation tools (using SAS) to test changes to the settlement system.

JOB DUTIES
Level I

- Assists with projects, as necessary, to implement ERCOT's Commercial Operations Systems, including future enhancements

- Assists with system development, product implementation, certification, and testing

- Develops and maintains a strong understanding of the competitive energy markets

- Identifies and recommends improvements to procedures and software that increase accuracy, efficiency, and timeliness

- Writes and executes SQL queries to generate results for analytical reports

- Writes and executes SAS code to certify system changes and verify calculations from the production system

- Resolves Market Participant questions, disputes, and data errors related to settlement computations

- Assists with day-to-day team activities

- Keeps the Senior and/or Lead Settlement Analyst informed of system issues through formal status reports and informal updates (email, team discussion)

- Notifies leadership of key issues in a timely manner

- Builds strong working relationships with Settlement Team members and colleagues across ERCOT departments

- Clearly communicates complex technical concepts, in writing and verbally, to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Supports the Settlement Team and collaborates with peers to meet team objectives and ERCOT initiatives

- Maintains working knowledge of market and power systems, and understands how data elements flow from these systems into the settlement system

Level II — Includes all Level I duties, plus:

- Demonstrates advanced knowledge and expertise in detailed settlement calculations

- Takes initiative to identify and recommend solutions and improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and timeliness

- Serves on projects to implement ERCOT's Commercial Operations Systems, including future enhancements

- Mentors other analysts within the department

- Applies knowledge of the software development lifecycle to complete tasks, enhance tools, and support effective process flow

Senior Level — Includes all Level I and II duties, plus:

- Provides on-the-job training and oversees the work of other analysts

- May lead projects to implement ERCOT's Commercial Operations Systems, including future enhancements

- Ensures the quality of deliverables and artifacts produced by Settlement Analysts

- Supports the Lead Settlement Analyst with day-to-day team activities

EXPERIENCE

- Level I: Requires no minimum work experience beyond degree requirements

- Level II: Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience beyond degree requirements

- Senior Level: Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience beyond degree requirements

EDUCATION

- Requires Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field (required), or an equivalent combination of education and experience

- Prefer proficient in Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and graphs

- Prefer comfortable interpreting and manipulating algebraic equations

- Prefer experience with, or aptitude for, SQL, Visual Basic, and SAS

WORK LOCATION

title: Power Systems Engineer 3 - Grid Analysis
description:
At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources.  We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career.

ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future.

As a Grid Analysis engineer at ERCOT, you will enter a collaborative place to influence and shape the reliability of the electric power grid while developing your engineering and leadership skills. Our world class operations teams work creatively to perform steady-state analysis using the most advanced power flow models and support ERCOT stakeholders in crafting requirements to reliability integrate new technologies.

Responsibility of the Grid Analysis includes, but are not limited to the following:

- Perform power-flow simulations to evaluate Constraint Management Plans (CMPs) and Remedial Action Schemes (RASs) using tools such as PowerWorld, PSSE, VSAT, etc.

- Perform regional power transfer analysis to identify potential wide-area cascading risks.

- Develop and maintain ERCOT’s Black Start Plan from resource selection to the restoration plan.

- Evaluate current performance of generator and transmission equipment against the reliability requirements and forecast future requirement needs.

- Propose and implement improvements which may include rule/requirement changes to maintain the reliability of the future grid.

JOB SUMMARY

Provide electrical engineering analysis and technical support for the operations of the electric power system. Implement appropriate system modeling, develop tools and procedures to monitor and control the system, perform system studies, analyze simulated or actual operating results, develop solutions to current or future system issues, and appropriately report findings and recommendations.

- Design and perform steady-state analyses using power flow models (PSSE, VSAT, or PowerWorld) under the direction of a senior level engineer or management.

- Assist in providing input and analyses from the operations perspective on market/protocol design issues to support other activities.

- Structure appropriate operations studies and sensitivity analyses to determine the need for Constraint Management Plans (CMPs) and regional power transfer interfaces.

- Help develop improvements to maintain reliability of the electric system.

- Serves as a technical Subject Matter Expert for the department.

- Make independent decisions except in instances of unusually complex engineering scenarios.

- Work on the most complex engineering issues where analysis of situations requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors.

- Ability to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways.

- May coordinate, provide presentations and participate in stakeholder meetings with ERCOT personnel and Market Participants.

- Foster and leverage strong working relationships with team and other internal departments.

- Lend professional expertise to guide projects and help teammates assigned by manager.

- Act as mentor and advisor to less experienced engineers/analysts.

- Lead multifunctional teams to obtain input, address comments and perform studies.

- Demonstrate skills as an expert user of power system software applications and tools, spreadsheet programs, and database programs.

- Maintain knowledge of emerging trends and industry best practices.

Engineer 1

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or related field, or a combination of education and experience that provides the applicant with knowledge equivalent to a major in such fields.

- Graduate Degree: Electrical Engineering or related field (Preferred).

Engineer 2

- Minimum 1 to 2 years (in excess of degree requirements stated above) of progressively responsible experience as a power system engineer or similar type role.

- Experience within the electric utility industry preferred.

Engineer 3

- Minimum 3 years (in excess of degree requirements stated above) of progressively responsible experience as a power system engineer or similar type role.

- Experience within the electric utility industry preferred.

Senior Engineer

- Minimum 5 years experience as a power system engineer or similar type role within the electric utility industry.

​
EDUCATION :

- Bachelor's Degree: Electrical Engineering or related field, or a combination of education and experience that provides the applicant with knowledge equivalent to a major in such fields.

- Graduate Degree: Electrical Engineering or related field (Preferred).

CERTIFICATION :

- PE (Professional Engineer) license is preferred but not required.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Power-flow simulation experience.

- Programming or scripting experience.

WORK LOCATION – Taylor, TX:

- On-site schedules are flexible or may be rotated based on business needs as determined by the Manager.

title: Compliance Analyst Sr - Operations and Planning
description:
At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources.  We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career.

ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future.

JOB SUMMARY
The Operations and Planning (O&P) Compliance role supports ERCOT's adherence to NERC Operations and Planning Reliability Standards and ERCOT Nodal Protocols, Operating Guides, and Other Binding Documents. The position collaborates with internal teams within the organization to identify and assess internal controls, consider compliance risks, and conduct remediation to ensure compliance with Federal Energy Regulatory Commission orders, North American Reliability Corporation Reliability (NERC) Standards, Regional Reliability Standards, ERCOT Nodal Protocols and Operating Guides, and corporate objectives (“requirements”). This role works closely with ERCOT personnel to identify the documentation and other controls related to the various requirements and ensures policies and procedures are in place to demonstrate compliance with requirements. This position acts as the primary liaison between the organization’s staff, regulatory agencies, and external auditors.

JOB DUTIES

Level 2

- Applies analytical and problem-solving skills to independently identify compliance risks and develop effective solutions.

- Uses compliance methods and tools to monitor and report on compliance with requirements, with moderate independence.

- Acts as a resource to advise process owners on improving processes and compliance posture.

- Works with assigned groups to develop, implement, and manage routine operations reports relevant to documenting and demonstrating performance compliance to requirements.

- Assists business process owners with oversight of remediation of issues resulting from internal and external audits, compliance investigations, and control assessments.

- Prepares ERCOT staff and documentation for NERC, Texas RE, and other external audits; maintains documentation of business processes and related internal controls; participates in audits as needed.

- Develops and maintains analytical documentation comparing current and revised NERC Operations and Planning Reliability Standards, ERCOT Nodal Protocols, Operating Guides, OBDs, and ERCOT policies; aligns obligations with internal controls, including business processes and procedures.

- Prepares and maintains NERC Reliability Standard Audit Worksheets (RSAWs), narratives, evidence, and internal controls for assigned Standards, coordinating with subject matter experts.

- Uses the Archer GRC platform to monitor, review, and assess the design and operational effectiveness of internal controls mapped to Reliability Standards and ERCOT Nodal Protocols requirements.

- Supports ERCOT's representation with NERC and Regional Standards Committees through participation on drafting teams or submission to development efforts.

- Develops or monitors recommendations providing guidance on NERC standards and ERCOT Regional Reliability standards directly impacting ERCOT systems, capabilities, and reliability.

- Participates in activities of developing or revising NERC Operations and Planning Reliability Standards, ERCOT Nodal Protocols, Operating Guides, and OBD provisions with ERCOT committees as applicable.

- Supports performance and Ancillary Services monitoring under ERCOT Nodal Protocols Section 8 and Nodal Operating Guides Section 9, including reporting to the Reliability Monitor.

Level Senior

- Coordinates and communicates on NERC Operations and Planning Reliability Standards, ERCOT Nodal Protocols, Operating Guides, and OBDs provisions with ERCOT committees and Board of Directors as needed.

- Develops and manages the process to collect and submit ERCOT feedback on NERC Operations and Planning Standards postings.

- Evaluates and maintains the relevance of traces from ERCOT Nodal Protocols, Operating Guides, OBDs, NERC Operations and Planning Reliability Standards, and corporate objectives to other ERCOT documentation.

- Facilitates the development of internal training regarding external audits and associated business processes and controls.

- Assists with coordination of external audits, including acting as a primary liaison between ERCOT staff and the auditors

- Updates compliance tools, tracks effort and progress of audits and investigations, and manages library of audit documentation

- Communicates technical compliance information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences and works effectively across cross-functional teams.

- Documents and tracks potential compliance issues (self-logs and self-reports) and responds to Requests for Information (RFIs) from regulators.

EXPERIENCE

- Level 2: Requires 2 years related work experience

- Level Senior: Require 5 years related work experience

- Prefer experience with NERC Operations and Planning Reliability Standards and the ERCOT Nodal Protocols, Operating Guides, and OBDs.

- Prefer experience with Bulk Electric System (BES) operations and/or planning, NERC compliance monitoring, RSAW and evidence development, and Texas Reliability Entity and/or NERC audits.

- Prefer experience with SQL, Cognos, Python, or other data analysis platforms

EDUCATION

- Bachelor's Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Accounting, Auditing or related field (Required)

CERTIFICATION

- CCEP Certified Compliance Ethics Professional (Preferred)

- NERC System Operator Certification (Preferred)

title: Operational Load Forecasting, SR  (Hybrid)
description:
At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources.  We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career.

ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future.

JOB SUMMARY
Provides analysis and technical support for ERCOT’s operational and planning load forecasting processes to ensure continuing reliable operations of the electric power grid in compliance with NERC Standards, ERCOT Protocols and Market Guides. Implements appropriate demand and load forecasting modeling, develops tools and procedures to monitor forecast performance, input data quality, model outputs, weather and demand conditions in support of system operators. Develops solutions for current or future demand and load forecasting issues, and appropriately reports findings and recommendations. Supports the evaluation and adoption of advanced analytics and emerging forecasting tools to improve forecast quality, situational awareness, and operational decision support.

JOB DUTIES

Operational Load Forecasting — Level 2 / Level 3

- Understands the basic principles, theories and concepts related to the profession and learns how to apply them within the ERCOT culture.

- Follows standard practices and procedures in analyzing situations or data from which answers can be readily obtained.

- Contributes to specific objectives and outcomes as directed.

Operational Load Forecasting Sr

- Understands and applies principles, theories and concepts related to the profession and ERCOT's culture.

- Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Impact is generally limited to specific assignments or projects.

- May respond to inquiries and/or provide assistance and/or guidance to lower level workers.

ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES

Operational Load Forecasting — Level 2 / Level 3

- Works under the direction of a senior-level analyst, Lead, supervisor, or manager to support ERCOT’s 0-to-11-day hourly and sub-hourly operational load forecast and related planning load forecasting assignments.

- Provides technical expertise to the ISO and Load Forecasting team for operational and planning load forecast analysis, including forecast production support, monitoring, and performance review.

- Supports the development , testing, implementation, documentation, and training of load forecasting methodologies , models, tools, and procedures.

- Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action.

- Supports load forecasting model runs, data quality checks, input/output validation, and historical database updates.

- Reviews and analyzes historical load, weather, calendar, and operational event data from ERCOT and  other relevant independent sources to validate, maintain, and improve statistical and time-series load forecasting models.

- Creates estimates for the ERCOT Control Area annual energy and monthly, daily, hourly, and peak models that involve economic forecasts, historical database updates and maintenance.

- Supports development of  the ERCOT, state, and sub-area hourly and sub-hourly forecasts for 0 to 11 days.

- Develops and enhances demand response models, and other energy models, including plug-in electric vehicles, distributed generation models, and other load modifier models.

- Develops and maintains forecast performance metrics, reports, dashboards, and recurring analyses.

- Supports analysis used to develop recommendations to Operations on load forecast, demand response, load modifier impacts, forecast uncertainty, and operational forecast risks, in coordination with the Operational Load Forecasting Lead, supervisor, or manager as appropriate.

- Provides load forecast and demand response recommendations to Operations, in coordination with the Operational Load Forecasting Lead, supervisor, or manager as appropriate.

- Participates in daily meetings with Operations and Outage Coordination staff, as assigned, to support communication of forecast changes, forecast risks, and operational implications.

- May support after-hours forecast review, event analysis, or operational forecast support as assigned. At times weekend on-call rotations will be required.

Operational Load Forecasting Sr — Above +

- Serves as a technical subject matter expert for operational and planning load forecasting, model development, validation, and performance analysis.

- Works independently on more complex forecast performance and uncertainty analysis, model validation, historical event review, and methodology support.

- Supports higher-volume and more complex recurring forecast reviews, reports, dashboards, and analysis requests.

- Assists in developing weather-driven forecasting analytics, decision-support tools, processes, and procedures that enhance forecast performance, input data quality, model review, and departmental efficiencies.

- Participates in multifunctional teams to obtain input, address comments, and support load forecasting studies, methodology changes, and process improvements.

- Provides guidance, on-the-job training, mentoring, or oversight to less experienced analysts on load forecasting model runs, data review, forecast performance analysis, and documentation as required.

- May support responses to executive and management inquiries and special reporting requests related to operational load forecasting, in coordination with Operational Load Forecasting Lead, supervisor, or manager as appropriate..

- May serve as a quality assurance and best practices resource for assigned load forecasting models, forecast performance analysis, reports, dashboards, and operational forecast support processes.

- Maintains knowledge of emerging trends and industry best practices applicable to load forecasting, operational forecasting, and forecast analytics.

EXPERIENCE

- Familiarity with wind and solar power generation is preferred. Experience with load forecasting, weather-driven analytics, statistical or time-series modeling, large datasets, and data analysis tools such as Python, R, SQL, SAS, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools is preferred.

Operational Load Forecasting — Level 2 / Level 3

- Level 2: Requires minimum 1 year job-related work experience in excess of degree requirements.

- Level 3: Requires minimum 3 years job-related work experience in excess of degree requirements.

Operational Load Forecasting Sr / Lead

- Senior: Requires minimum 5 years job-related work experience in excess of degree requirements.

- Lead: Requires minimum 8 years job-related work experience in excess of degree requirements.

EDUCATION

- Bachelor’s Degree: Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or Meteorology required.

- Master’s Degree: Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or Meteorology preferred.

- A combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge to a major in such fields is required.
